initial_findings: First expansion import and art/source gates passed; later runs reused that imported resource set. Initial import raw logs are retained.
Programmatic LineEdit.text assignment in the test did not emit text_changed; test now emits the actual search signal explicitly.

Native idle test incorrectly assumed the render_target_update_mode getter changes from UPDATE_ONCE to UPDATE_DISABLED. It now observes retained pixels across idle frames, changes the background without requesting a frame, and then verifies that an explicit render request updates the pixels.
Native rendering uses a retained TextureRect/own SubViewport with explicit render requests; pointer selection through the displayed texture is exercised.
Early failed headless/native logs are diagnostic history, not passing completion evidence.
limits: Standalone local authoring editor, not integrated campaign state or flight.

Paging retains twelve metadata entries, with at most two synchronous file reads (each at most 2 MiB) and 32 directory entries per tick. The 3 ms budget is cooperative, not a worst-case latency guarantee.
Directory offsets assume unchanged enumeration between page requests; no indexed sorting or snapshot isolation under external file changes.
Selection timing is a CPU authoring probe, not a target-PC FPS or GPU benchmark. Idle optimization covers the 3D viewport, not the whole application.
No full-suite/merged-tree, Windows-export or campaign acceptance; no schema/revision/balancing changes.
